summary: Preserved the candidate's weighted tokenizer-side admission and added provisional ASGI admission before request-body consumption. The provisional lease is atomically resized to the parsed media-item count, released for text-only requests, and otherwise retained through the candidate's preprocessing/scheduler-handoff lifetime. This fixes the independently reproduced Python HTTP frontend counterexample without claiming validation of unavailable architectures or the exact Kimi-K2.6 workload.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction against exact candidate e3da2b295dcd70b2c65158c3458006ea03f2b9b4: with budget one already occupied, 32 parsed 4 MiB payloads (134218464 bytes) were retained before 32/32 busy rejections; maximum RSS grew 134796 KiB. See evidence/candidate-adversarial-before.log.

Passing-after focused regression: 11 passed. The 32-request, 4 MiB-per-body ASGI case allowed one request to call receive(), rejected the remaining 31 with HTTP 503 before receive(), and returned admission accounting to zero. Lease resizing, rollback, background-future ownership, and weighted counting also passed.

tests.what_was_measured: Consolidated candidate and correction regression: 457 passed, 2 HIP-inapplicable context-parallel tests deselected, 58 subtests passed. See evidence/consolidated-regression.log.
Repository formatting, import sorting, lint, secret, syntax, CI registry, and related source checks passed on the correction files. See evidence/pre-commit-rerun.log.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution applies to this Python ASGI/admission-accounting correction. The prepared environment reports Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2 and a visible AMD Instinct MI350X, but no model-semantic or GPU numerical claim is made. See evidence/environment.log.

remaining_limitations: Kimi-K2.6 weights and an equivalent 1.5 TiB host were unavailable, so the exact 200-concurrent-request, 28-images-per-request OOM and end-to-end prevention remain unverified.
The Rust frontend owns a separate request and multimodal preprocessing pipeline; the option remains rejected there and this Python ASGI correction does not qualify that architecture.
EPD language-only mode can dispatch preprocessing to a remote encoder; the option remains rejected there because a correct cross-process ownership protocol was not available or validated.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is text-only and cannot qualify multimodal preprocessing, Kimi-K2.6 semantics, or a distributed workload, so it was not used as substitute evidence.
ASGI admission prevents excess application-level body consumption; transport implementations may still retain bounded per-connection protocol buffers before the application calls receive().
Two unrelated context-parallel tests invoke prefill CP, which production validation explicitly deprecates on HIP; the consolidated applicable run deselected only those two cases.
